title: wunderweb document
description: Roots: Page, Fragment. Generated by wunderweb from core v1 + theme + blocks - do not edit.

ContainerSize.description: Content width of a box; its background stays full width.

SignedSpacing.description: Spacing step; negative pulls the box over its neighbour.

RichText.description: HTML limited to the rich text vocabulary.

Svg.description: Inline SVG markup: one <svg> root, no scripts, handlers or root style.

Url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, root-relative path, mailto:, tel:, #anchor, page:<id>[#anchor] (page in the current locale) or consent:settings (opens the cookie settings; needs a consent section in the site config).

Path.description: Site path without locale prefix and trailing slash.

BackgroundPosition.description: cover | contain | fill stretch the asset; anchors keep its natural size.

EdgeShape.description: Shape of a box edge; cuts into the neighbour.

Asset.description: Image or video. A root-relative url resolves against the configured asset base (e.g. an S3 bucket).

Button.description: Needs url or opens, unless the field holding it is marked actionOptional (e.g. a form submit).

label.description: Visible text; with iconOnly the accessible name.

opens.description: Fragment shown in a dialog; the page renders each dialog once. With an #anchor url the dialog is the fallback, used when the anchor is not on the page.

iconOnly.description: Show only the icon, e.g. a scroll-down chevron.

Icon.description: SVG or short text glyph (e.g. a step number). Needs svg or text.

text.description: Glyph instead of an SVG, e.g. "1".

background.description: Fills the shape behind the icon.

SignedSides.description: Negative only vertically (overlap with the block above / below).

BoxLayout.description: Inside of the box: its children are stacked (before, content, after).

container.description: Constrain the children to the page container; background stays full width.

alignY.description: Vertical distribution of the children (needs height, e.g. minHeight).

textAlign.description: Inherited by all text in the box. A text-align-* class on an element wins over it (unless a block documents otherwise).

Placement.description: Outside of the box: how it sits in its parent.

x.description: Horizontal self-alignment, e.g. center a narrow block.

y.description: Vertical self-alignment in a row or cell.

colSpan.description: Only in slots whose block allows it (rule childPlace), e.g. grid tiles.

rowSpan.description: Only in slots whose block allows it (rule childPlace), e.g. grid tiles.

angle.description: Linear only, degrees; 180 = top to bottom.

Background.description: Layers, back to front - base, asset, color overlay, gradients, content.

base.description: Fill behind the asset (shows while it loads or where it is transparent).

color.description: Overlay color over the asset; with opacity a tint.

opacity.description: Applies to the color overlay if set, else to the asset.

parallax.description: The asset scrolls slower than the page.

Decoration.description: Graphic pinned to the box, e.g. an ornament overlapping its edge. Takes no space, never clipped by its own box; clipped by the nearest ancestor with layout.clip.

offsetX.description: px from the anchored side; negative = outside the box.

block.description: Replacement: any PageBlock-role block except Include; must be allowed where the slot sits (checked after substitution).

Page.description: Locale = content folder. Pages with the same id in different locales are translations.

id.description: Translation id, shared across locales; target of page:<id> links. Unset = file name.

path.description: URL path without the locale prefix, e.g. /meine-seite; / = home.

chrome.description: false = no site header and footer.

Fragment.description: Reusable blocks, placed with Include (shared sections, header, footer).

ForcedAlign.description: inherit = no override (the text's own alignment).

PlayMode.description: lightbox = poster with play button; the video opens in an overlay.

SplitRatio.description: start:end column proportion, parts sum to at most 24, e.g. 7:5.

Split.description: Columns stay stacked below the first breakpoint with a ratio.

reverse.description: Show end left of start. Stacked order stays start, end.

alignY.description: Vertical alignment of the two columns.

TileMode.description: grid = equal columns, cells may span; flex = wrapping row; masonry = columns filled top-down.

visible.description: Show the items per breakpoint; before / after and the box stay.

PageBlock.description: Top-level block of a page or fragment. Role; blocks: Buttons, Card, Feed, Media, Text, Stack, SideBySide, Tiles, Include, Section.

Row.description: Block that lays out Content side by side or in a grid. Role; blocks: Buttons, Card, Feed, Media, Text, Stack, SideBySide, Tiles.

Content.description: Block holding Leaf blocks, or a Leaf. Role; blocks: Buttons, Card, Feed, Media, Text, Stack.

Leaf.description: Content block without block slots (text, media, card, …). Role; blocks: Buttons, Card, Feed, Media, Text.

Inline.description: Block allowed in the surround slots (before / after) of any block. Role; blocks: Buttons, Media, Text.

id.description: Stable block id, unique within the file (editor metadata, not passed to components). `wunderweb format` fills it in.

with.description: Per-page content for slots of the fragment: a block with the same slot id is replaced.

slot.description: In a fragment: id a page can replace via Include.with.

visible.description: Per breakpoint, e.g. {base: false, lg: true}. Hides the whole block including before / after and background.
